channel.title: EU Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA) — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by EU Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA) (enisa).

image.title: EU Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA) — recent CVEs

item.title: CVE-2026-112165 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Disabled TLS Certificate Validation Enables MITM Attacks
item.description: The LaserGest mobile application disables TLS certificate and hostname verification via setServerTrustMode("nocheck"), allowing a man-in-the-middle attacker to intercept or modify network traffic, including credentials and API communications.

item.title: CVE-2026-112164 · 6.6 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Hardcoded AES Key Enables Credential Disclosure
item.description: The LaserGest mobile application encrypts stored assistance portal credentials with a hardcoded AES key and IV, allowing an attacker with access to the application package to recover them in cleartext.

item.title: CVE-2026-103906 · 7.8 HIGH 🌩️ — Disabled TLS Certificate Validation Enables MITM Attacks
item.description: Use of hard-coded MQTT credentials in the AM CLUB mobile application allows an authenticated attacker to connect to the MQTT broker and access data or perform actions across tenant boundaries.

item.title: CVE-2026-112171 · 4.4 MEDIUM — SQL injection vulnerability in Magistra software
item.description: An attacker can inject malicious SQL statements through user-controlled input, allowing unauthorized access to, modification of, or disclosure of database data.

item.title: CVE-2026-112170 · 6.3 MEDIUM — Improper verification of downloaded upgrades
item.description: The software downloads upgrade files without performing integrity checks, allowing the installation of tampered updates.

item.title: CVE-2026-112169 · 6.1 MEDIUM — Undocumented backdoor allows authentication bypass in Magistra software
item.description: Magistra software contains undocumented backdoor functionality that allows authentication bypass and the creation of a privileged user account without credential verification.

item.title: CVE-2026-112168 · 6 MEDIUM — Multiple embedded secrets and weak algorithms in Magistra
item.description: The Magistra software uses weak custom encryption, relies on an outdated compression algorithm to protect the database, and contains embedded secrets.

item.title: CVE-2026-118798 · 4.4 MEDIUM — Multiple sensitive authentication data exposed
item.description: Multiple sensitive authentication data, including credentials, OAuth-related secrets, session information, and authentication artifacts, are exposed through application logs and persistent client-side storage, enabling unauthorized access and session…

item.title: CVE-2026-118795 · 5.9 MEDIUM — AIS stores authorization state in locally modifiable databases
item.description: Administrative roles and module permissions are stored in mutable local database fields, allowing privilege escalation for attackers with database write access.

item.title: CVE-2026-118792 · 6.1 MEDIUM — Default ODBC credentials
item.description: Default credentials permit access through AcuXDBC.

item.title: CVE-2026-118791 · 7.2 HIGH 🌩️ — Insecure software update mechanism
item.description: The application implements software update functionality without adequate authenticity and integrity validation, allowing update packages to be accepted without sufficient cryptographic verification.

item.title: CVE-2026-118790 · 7.2 HIGH 🌩️ — Multiple Hardcoded Credentials
item.description: Multiple hardcoded credentials are embedded within product components and administrative functionalities. These credentials may enable unauthorized access to privileged accounts, services, or application features across affected deployments.

item.title: CVE-2026-118468 · 7.2 HIGH 🌩️ — AIS XML parsers allow external entity resolution
item.description: XML parsers process attacker-influenced update manifests or network responses with external entity resolution enabled, potentially allowing XML External Entity (XXE) attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-118467 · 4.3 MEDIUM — AIS products expose clinical and personal data via logs and telemetry
item.description: Shared telemetry and logging components store or transmit patient and doctor identifiers, clinical information, and low-entropy identifiers without adequate pseudonymization or protection.

item.title: CVE-2026-118465 · 5.8 MEDIUM — AIS products use vendor-wide hard-coded database credentials
item.description: Shared components expose hard-coded Access, workgroup, CCBasic, DBISAM, and related database credentials that are identical across installations.

item.title: CVE-2026-118464 · 5.8 MEDIUM — AIS shared cryptographic services use fixed cryptographic secrets
item.description: Shared cryptographic services use fixed vendor-wide secrets, deterministic IVs, null salts, and reversible transformations to protect credentials, IPC data, configuration values, and clinical fields.

item.title: CVE-2026-118462 · 9.2 CRITICAL 🌩️ — AIS update mechanism executes unverified code
item.description: Update components download and execute code without proper authenticity verification, relying on ignored hashes or forgeable checksums. Some update paths also permit archive traversal or script execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-118461 · 8 HIGH 🌩️ — AIS PersonnelService client performs unauthenticated doctor-specific operations
item.description: The shared client accepts caller-controlled doctor identifiers for read and write operations without requiring authentication or authorization credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-118460 · 8 HIGH 🌩️ — AIS embedded private keys enable practitioner impersonation
item.description: Embedded private keys protected by a shared password can be used to sign practitioner assertions for arbitrary practitioner identifiers, enabling unauthorized practitioner token requests.

item.title: CVE-2026-118459 · 6.3 MEDIUM 🌩️ — AIS PasswordSOS permits authentication without legitimate credentials
item.description: A time-derived emergency password can be derived from publicly available application code, enabling authentication without legitimate credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-118458 · 8.1 HIGH 🌩️ — AIS shared test login provider contains fixed administrative credentials
item.description: The shared AIS login routing selects a production-shipped test DAO and plaintext comparison for the H and V application codes, accepting fixed administrator accounts.

item.title: CVE-2026-118450 · 5.9 MEDIUM — Venere loads replaceable unsigned components from a writable installation location
item.description: Venere is installed outside Program Files and loads/registers unsigned components from locations where an unprivileged user may create files.

item.title: CVE-2026-112172 · 8.1 HIGH 🌩️ — Unauthenticated SQL Execution in XDent/XMedical Synchronization Infrastructure
item.description: CGM XDent and XMedical expose PHP synchronization endpoints that allow unauthenticated attackers to manipulate session variables and execute arbitrary SQL queries against backend MySQL databases.
